name: Nordreth Unit 112 Original
description: This listing is a footwall-drive fabrication bay listed with depth below grade 160 metres, floor area 575 square metres, occupancy 53 people. Its remaining stated figures are session length 10 hours, session fee set after acceptance, access route stair shaft.
